observation.visible_scene: A bathroom interior centered on a wall-mounted rectangular mirror. A person with long brown hair, glasses, and an olive-green jacket stands facing the mirror, holding a smartphone horizontally with both hands at eye level (self-recording). The mirror reflection shows a plain wall with a horizontal metal towel bar and a doorway on the right. On the camera's own side of the room, framed black fern prints hang on the left wall and a white waffle-textured towel hangs from a rack at the right edge.
visible_changes: The camera framing widens progressively over the excerpt: at the start the mirror's top border is outside the view and the mirror nearly fills the frame, while by the end the full rectangular mirror frame (top and bottom edges) plus more of the surrounding textured wall are visible.

The person's reflection remains roughly centered in the mirror and at a similar size relative to the mirror throughout, holding the phone steadily up to the face; only minor adjustments of the hands, phone, and head are seen.

The reflected towel bar, doorway, and the room-side towel and framed prints stay fixed in relation to the mirror; their apparent positions change only as a consequence of the widening camera framing, not from their own motion.
outside_clip_unknowns: The beginning and end of the recording session and any pose changes outside this segment.
Whether the person ultimately moves, lowers the phone, or leaves the frame after the clip.
The full layout of the room beyond the visible mirror and wall edges.
uncertain_details: Whether the framing change is a lens zoom-out or a physical step-back/pan of the camera.
The cause of the small hand and head tremors (deliberate adjustment vs. handheld shake).
